name: research-paper
description: Academic papers and research documents. Emphasizes citations, methodology, and scholarly rigor.

custom.name: thesis
custom.description: Core argument, research questions, hypotheses, and the central thesis statement with supporting rationale

custom.name: methodology
custom.description: Research methodology, data collection methods, analysis approach, experimental design, and validation procedures

custom.name: literature
custom.description: Literature review structure, key citations to incorporate, theoretical framework, and positioning relative to existing work

custom.name: evidence
custom.description: Data sources, evidence requirements, statistical methods, figures and tables strategy, and reproducibility requirements

custom.name: publication
custom.description: Target publication venue, formatting requirements, submission timeline, peer review strategy, and revision planning

workflowEmphasis: Establish clear research questions and hypotheses
Plan peer review and revision cycles
guidance.documentationFocus: Research methodology, literature citations, evidence presentation, and academic formatting requirements
keyConsiderations: What is the core research question or thesis?
What methodology best supports the research goals?
Are all claims properly cited and supported?
Does the structure follow target venue guidelines?
What data or evidence is needed to support conclusions?
How will results be validated and reproduced?
What figures and tables are needed to present findings?
